summary: molearn is a Python package designed to model and generate protein conformational spaces using machine learning. Unlike methods focused on classifying molecular dynamics frames, it learns a low-dimensional latent representation of protein ensembles and can generate new conformations from latent-space coordinates. The package handles data via tools like PDBData and DataAssembler, relying on MDAnalysis. It employs autoencoder-based neural models, including convolutional approaches, to encode and reconstruct protein structures. Users can explore, interpolate, sample, and decode latent spaces to produce new conformations. molearn incorporates physics-aware components, such as ModifiedForceField and OpenMM-based energy functions, allowing molecular-energy information to regularize model training.
